timelines.title: Grand Finale: Divya Ganesh Wins Bigg Boss Tamil 9!
timelines.message: In the Grand Finale hosted by Vijay Sethupathi, wildcard entrant Divya Ganesh won Bigg Boss Tamil Season 9! Sabarinathan finished 1st Runner-up, Vikkals Vikram 2nd Runner-up, and Aurora Sinclair 3rd Runner-up.

timelines.title: Sandra Amy Evicted
timelines.message: Sandra Amy was evicted on Day 98 in the final pre-finale elimination.

timelines.title: Vinoth Walks Out with ₹17.6 Lakh Cash Box
timelines.message: Gana Vinoth Kumar voluntarily walked out on Day 96 after accepting the ₹17,63,500 Cash Box offer.

timelines.title: Subiksha Kumar Evicted
timelines.message: Subiksha Kumar was evicted on Day 91 after receiving the lowest public votes.

timelines.title: Kamrudin K & VJ Parvathy Ejected by Host
timelines.message: On Day 90, host Vijay Sethupathi ejected Kamrudin K and VJ Parvathy from the house for serious rule violations regarding private whispering.

timelines.title: Aurora Sinclair Wins Ticket to Finale
timelines.message: Aurora Sinclair scored 47 points across the Ticket to Finale tasks, becoming the first official finalist of Season 9.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Amit Bhargav & Kani Thiru
timelines.message: Wildcard Amit Bhargav and Kani Thiru received the lowest public votes and were evicted on Days 83 and 84.

timelines.title: Kamrudin Wins Week 12 Captaincy; Family Week
timelines.message: Kamrudin K won the captaincy task. The emotional Freeze and Release Family Week began on Days 78–82.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: FJ & Aadhirai
timelines.message: Ex-captain FJ and re-entry contestant Aadhirai Soundarajan were evicted together in a double eviction on Day 77.

timelines.title: Gana Vinoth Kumar Wins Week 11 Captaincy
timelines.message: Gana Vinoth Kumar won the captaincy task against Aadhirai, Amit, Aurora, Parvathy, and Subiksha to become Week 11 captain.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Ramya Joo & Viyana
timelines.message: Ex-captain Ramya Joo and Viyana were evicted together in a double eviction on Days 69 and 70.

timelines.title: Amit Bhargav Wins Week 10 Captaincy
timelines.message: Wildcard entry Amit Bhargav won the captaincy task to become Week 10 captain.

timelines.title: Prajean Padmanabhan Evicted
timelines.message: Wildcard entry Prajean Padmanabhan received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 63.

timelines.title: Ramya Joo Wins Week 9 Captaincy
timelines.message: Ramya Joo won the tube-sliding captaincy task to become Week 9 captain.

timelines.title: Severe Weather in Tamil Nadu: No Eviction
timelines.message: Due to severe weather conditions across Tamil Nadu, host Vijay Sethupathi announced that no eviction would take place on Day 55.

timelines.title: FJ Retains Captaincy; Aadhirai Re-enters
timelines.message: FJ won the tube balancing task to retain captaincy. Previously evicted contestant Aadhirai Soundarajan re-entered the house on Day 56.

timelines.title: Kemy Evicted
timelines.message: Vyishali Kemkar (Kemy) was evicted on Day 49 after getting the fewest public votes in the Maruti Suzuki eviction challenge.

timelines.title: FJ Wins Week 7 Captaincy
timelines.message: Fredrick Johnson (FJ) won the board-grip captaincy task to become Week 7 captain.

timelines.title: T. Diwagar Evicted
timelines.message: T. Diwagar received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 42 following the Bigg Boss Samrajiyam kingdom task.

timelines.title: Sabarinathan Wins Week 6 Captaincy
timelines.message: Sabarinathan won the garden captaincy task against Divya and Parvathy to become Week 6 captain.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Tushaar & Praveen
timelines.message: In a Week 5 double eviction, ex-captain Tushaar Jayaprakash and Praveen Raj Dev were evicted on Days 34 and 35.

timelines.title: Divya Ganesh Wins Week 5 Captaincy
timelines.message: Wildcard entrant Divya Ganesh won the wildcard-exclusive captaincy task, becoming Week 5 captain.

timelines.title: Kalaiyarasan Evicted; 4 Wildcards Enter
timelines.message: Kalaiyarasan was evicted on Day 28. Four wildcard entrants (Amit Bhargav, Divya Ganesh, Prajean Padmanabhan, Sandra Amy) entered the house.

timelines.title: Praveen Raj Dev Wins Week 4 Captaincy
timelines.message: Praveen Raj Dev won the velcro ski board captaincy task to become Week 4 captain.

timelines.title: Aadhirai Evicted; Wildcards Announced
timelines.message: Aadhirai Soundarajan was evicted on Day 21. Host Vijay Sethupathi announced upcoming wildcard entries.

timelines.title: Kani Thiru Wins Week 3 Captaincy
timelines.message: Kani Thiru won the captaincy challenge to lead the house in Week 3.

timelines.title: Apsara CJ Evicted
timelines.message: Apsara CJ was evicted on Day 14 after receiving the fewest public votes.

timelines.title: Tushaar Jayaprakash Wins Week 2 Captaincy
timelines.message: Tushaar Jayaprakash won the captaincy task to become Week 2 captain (later revoked on Day 11 due to duty performance).

timelines.title: Pravin Gandhi Evicted
timelines.message: Film director Pravin Gandhi received the lowest public votes and became the first evicted contestant of Season 9 on Day 7.

timelines.title: Week 1 Nominations
timelines.message: Aadhirai, Apsara, Diwagar, Kalaiyarasan, Praveen, Pravin Gandhi, and Viyana were nominated for the season's first eviction.

timelines.title: Grand Premiere: Bigg Boss Tamil Season 9 Launch
timelines.message: Host Vijay Sethupathi introduced 20 housemates in the launch of Bigg Boss Tamil Season 9. Housemates chose between fire (red) and water (blue) bands affecting house privileges. On Day 5, Nandhini R voluntarily walked out of the house.
